- Elif < Ann
- Elif < Gus (satisfied by block)
- Gus < Ivo
- Ben < Finn
- Dev < Ben
- Hana and Ivo at least 3 apart

Cara < Dev < Ben < Hana < Elif < Finn < Gus

Ann must be after Elif and before Ivo, with Ann–Ivo consecutive. Gus < Ivo. So Ann–Ivo must come after Gus (since Ann > Elif, and if Ann were between Elif and Gus, Ivo would be right after Ann, possibly before Gus — but Gus < Ivo forces Ivo after Gus, so Ann must be after Gus).

So order: Cara, Dev, Ben, Hana, Elif, Finn, Gus, Ann, Ivo.

All constraints satisfied.
